Classes, Innate Techniques, Races, Feats, Backgrounds, Equipment, Macros, Roll Tables and the full rules journal.
Import.ConfirmUpdate: Re-import all JJK 5e V.6 compendiums? Their current contents will be replaced. Items already on actors are not touched.
Import.ModulePacks: JJK 5e: compendiums are now built into the module (Compendium tab → "JJK 5e V.6"). No import needed.
Import.RemoveOld:
The JJK 5e compendiums now ship inside the module. This world still has {n} old imported copies.

Characters were re-linked to the new compendiums. Delete the old copies?

CE.Name: Cursed Energy
CE.ShortRestPrompt: Hit Dice to spend for CE (max {cap}). Mark the Hit Dice as spent on the sheet.
CE.AbilityPrompt: Cursed Energy ability for {name}. It sets the CE pool, the CE save DC (8 + PB + mod) and CE attack rolls (via the sheet's spellcasting ability).
CE.NegativeEmotionConfirm: Confirm that a qualifying event happened during combat in genuine danger.

Technique.Title: Choose Innate Technique
Technique.Current: Current: {name}. Changing it does not delete old features.
Technique.ChangeRemoves: This removes {n} items of the old innate technique from this character. Back up the actor first.

BlackFlash.Success: Critical damage uses 3× dice and ignores resistances. You enter (or stack) The Zone.
BlackFlash.Damage: critical dice tripled. Remember: this damage ignores resistances.

Zone.Name: The Zone
Zone.Description: The Zone (1 minute): advantage on attack rolls, +1 critical range and +1 Black Flash range per stack, recover Technique Burnout and RCT pool, lower Reduced Output by 1.

Domain.SureHitAttack: this technique attack counts as a hit against targets you choose inside your domain.
Domain.SureHitSave: targets you choose inside your domain automatically fail this saving throw.
Domain.Description: Domain open (1 minute). When it ends (or you delete this effect), Technique Burnout is applied automatically.
Domain.OutsideHint: Creatures outside take {n}d6 bludgeoning and are pushed to the edge (apply manually).
Domain.ClashWon: {name} wins the domain clash: sure hit restored.
Domain.WeakMissed: {name} can't find the weak spot (Perception {total} vs DC 30).
Domain.ClashEqual: Equal refinement: the domains cancel out. At 1/3 HP each caster rolls a flat DC 15 or loses the domain.
Domain.ClashResult: {win} overpowers {lose} (+{diff} refinement): {lose}'s domain breaks in {rounds} rounds, shrinking 15 ft per round.
Domain.ClashNoSureHit: Sure hit is negated for both domains during the clash.
Domain.ClashShrink: {name}'s domain shrinks to {r} ft ({rounds} rounds left).
Domain.EqualCheck: Domain clash: keep the domain (DC 15, no modifiers)
Domain.BarrierlessPrompt: Expand without a barrier? No time limit, 655 ft radius; the domain only breaks if you take 1/3 of your maximum HP in one hit and fail a CON save (DC 15 + half the damage).
Domain.BarrierlessDescription: Barrierless Domain: no barrier, no time limit, 655 ft radius. Taking 1/3 of your max HP in one instance forces a CON save (DC 15 + half the damage) or the domain is destroyed.
Domain.BarrierlessStats: No barrier · radius {radius} ft · no time limit
Domain.IncompleteDescription: Incomplete Domain: 100 ft, 1 minute, refinement 0, no barrier and no sure hit. Advantage on technique attack rolls; creatures inside have disadvantage on saves against your Innate Technique. Effects are halved.
Domain.IncompleteStats: Incomplete Domain · {radius} ft · no barrier, no sure hit
Domain.SelectAttacker: Select a token you control first.
Domain.BarrierAttackHint: Enter the attack bonus, maximum reach/range in feet, and simple damage formula. The GM reviews player requests. The side and distance are measured automatically.
Domain.AttackRejected: Barrier attack rejected: verify the target, distance, formula and GM approval.
Domain.AmplificationBlocks: Domain Amplification prevents innate technique use.
Domain.ProfileHint: GM-approved homebrew profile. Applied manually to selected targets; edit only while the domain is closed.
Domain.ProfileInvalid: Invalid domain profile; nothing was changed.
Domain.ProfileRunConfirm: Apply the approved effect to eligible selected targets? Verify targeting, timing and the approved homebrew rules.
Domain.ProfileSimpleDomain: Simple Domain: adjudicate barrier absorption before applying the effect.

Ward.FallingBlossom: Falling Blossom Emotion: negates only attacks and effects that are guaranteed to hit.
Ward.HollowWicker: Hollow Wicker Basket: the chosen creatures within 15 ft are protected from guaranteed hits.
Ward.Amplification: Domain Amplification: your innate techniques are blocked and you are protected from guaranteed hits. The GM adjudicates other neutralizations and Maximum Output.
Ward.FallingBlossomOffense: Falling Blossom Emotion (offense): one melee counterattack as a reaction before an incoming attack, with advantage, a critical on a hit and necrotic damage. The GM resolves the counterattack.
Ward.SimpleDomain: Simple Domain: a barrier of its own with {hp} HP that absorbs guaranteed-hit damage; it ends if you move, and leftover damage carries over to the protected creature. Ordinary Midi-QOL damage is resolved by the GM.

Domain.MarkerUseAttack: JJK 5e: to hit a selected barrier marker, use the barrier attack button.
Domain.MultiClashHint: Sure-hit effects are disabled until the clash resolves. Every losing barrier shrinks each round.
Domain.NeedWeakSpot: {name} is inside the domain and has not found its weak spot (DC 30 Perception): the barrier cannot be damaged from inside yet.
Domain.CloseFailed: JJK 5e: the domain could not be closed (no active GM or the GM declined).

Burnout.Name: Technique Burnout
Burnout.Description: After a Domain Expansion: no Innate Technique features and 2 levels of exhaustion for 1 minute or until you land a Black Flash.
Burnout.RecoveryUnavailable: Burnout Recovery needs Technique Burnout, Reverse Cursed Technique and 750+ domain refinement.
Burnout.RecoverySuccess: {name} rebuilds their brain: Technique Burnout ends.
Burnout.RecoveryFail: Burnout Recovery failed: 8d6 psychic damage, no actions or bonus actions until the start of your next turn.
Burnout.SummonDescription: Its summoner is in Technique Burnout: it stays but cannot move or act, its abilities and auras stop working, and it is treated as stunned. If it was flying, it falls prone.
Burnout.FormsEnded: Forms and magical effects of the technique end

Output.Title: Output
Output.MaxPrompt: Base CE cost of the technique you amplify (minimum 5, or 3 for a shikigami summon):
Output.TooLow: Maximum Output needs a base cost of at least 5 CE (3 for shikigami).
Output.ShikigamiOnly: A base cost under 5 only works for shikigami summoning techniques.
Output.Check: Cursed Energy check vs Reduced Output (DC {dc})
Output.Benefits: Choose one: range +50%, one damage roll +50% dice, attack bonus +50% (DC + half PB), duration +50%, or another value +50%. Shikigami: size +1 with an extra necrotic die, HP +50%, or attack + half PB.
Output.ReducedDescription: Lowers the CE range of techniques by the Output penalty. A technique whose base cost exceeds the Max cannot be used (enforced by the module). Not using CE for 1 minute or landing a Black Flash removes 1 level.

Soul.Name: Soul Damage
Soul.Description: Soul Damage: maximum HP −{total} until a long rest. Reverse Cursed Technique and regeneration cannot restore it.
Soul.DescriptionLasting: Soul Damage: maximum HP −{total}. Reverse Cursed Technique and regeneration cannot restore it; the GM removes it.
Soul.HealRCTUnavailable: Needs Soul Damage, Reverse Cursed Technique, 6+ levels of Soul Awareness and healing left in the RCT pool.
Soul.HealRCTPrompt: CE to spend (1 CE = 10 HP from the RCT pool, max {max}). Soul Damage: −{sd}.
Soul.HealRCTDone: {name} restores {healed} maximum HP with RCT (Soul Damage left: −{rest}).

rleg.broken: Movement is halved and you can't jump.
rleg.lost: You lose your right leg. Movement is halved.

lleg.broken: Movement is halved and you can't jump.
lleg.lost: You lose your left leg. Movement is halved.

rarm.broken: Skill checks and attack rolls using this arm have disadvantage.
rarm.lost: Skill checks and attack rolls with this arm are impossible.

larm.broken: Skill checks and attack rolls using this arm have disadvantage.
larm.lost: Skill checks and attack rolls with this arm are impossible.

torso.lost: The target dies unless it can live without a torso.

head.lost: The target dies unless it can live without a head.

Summon.Title: Summons
Summon.Dismiss: Dismiss all my summons in this scene
Summon.NotFound: JJK 5e: no actor named "{name}" in the world or compendiums.
Summon.Hint: Searches your actors (folder "JJK Shikigami") and then the compendiums (SRD). Tokens appear next to yours; the GM must be online.
Summon.NeedName: Write the name of the shikigami or creature to summon.
Summon.NotASummon: JJK 5e: Not a summon: {name} cannot be given to a player.

Panel.NoPool: No Cursed Energy pool yet: add a JJK class.
Panel.KeysEditable: Change them in Game Settings → Configure Controls → JJK 5e.
Panel.GMHint: GM tools: only you see this tab.

Notify.NotOwner: JJK 5e: you do not own that actor.
Notify.HRNoTechnique: JJK 5e: Heavenly Restriction has no Innate Technique.

Notify.NoPoolNotSpent: JJK 5e: {name} has no Cursed Energy pool, CE was not spent.

Notify.TechniqueSet: JJK 5e: {name} technique set to {technique} (no new features for this level).
Notify.NoGM: JJK 5e: a GM must be connected to summon or dismiss tokens.
Notify.NeedDnd5e: JJK 5e V.6 requires the D&D 5e system.
Notify.NoInspiration: JJK 5e: {name} has no inspiration to use this mindset.
Notify.GMOnly: Only the GM can do this.
Notify.GMDeclined: The GM declined or did not answer the request.

Notify.CloneNoTech: JJK 5e: Clone: this copy cannot use innate techniques.

Notify.HitDiceIncomplete: JJK 5e: Hit Dice allocation incomplete; the GM should review it.

Notify.AskGM: JJK 5e: Ask the GM to perform this action (player requests are off).
Notify.QuickRecoveryUnverified: JJK 5e: Quick Recovery — the feature's use could not be verified; check its uses and restore the CE by hand.
Notify.CEPendingRest: JJK 5e: settle the pending CE reservations (GM) before resting.
Notify.FullTurnUsed: Full-Turn Action: you already used your action or bonus action this turn.

autoSpendCE.Name: Automatic Cursed Energy spending
autoSpendCE.Hint: Features with a fixed CE cost spend it from the Cursed Energy pool and are blocked if there is not enough CE. Scaled costs use the scaling field.

transactionalCE.Name: Experimental GM-authoritative CE transactions
transactionalCE.Hint: Development preview. Requires active GM and working libWrapper activity adapter. A failed or interrupted consumption is held for explicit GM review. Do not enable in a live campaign before testing.

ceChat.Name: Cursed Energy chat messages
ceChat.Hint: Post a short chat line every time CE is spent or regained.

ceResource.Name: Cursed Energy resource slot
ceResource.Hint: Mirror the CE pool in this actor resource so it can be shown as a token bar and edited there.

autoTokenBar.Name: Show CE as token bar
autoTokenBar.Hint: If a token has no second bar, use it for Cursed Energy.

blackFlash.Name: Automatic Black Flash checks
blackFlash.Hint: On a melee critical hit by a player character (not Heavenly Restriction) roll a d20 for Black Flash and apply / stack The Zone.

blackFlashDamage.Name: Black Flash triple damage
blackFlashDamage.Hint: After a Black Flash the next critical damage roll uses 3× dice instead of 2×.

zoneAdvantage.Name: The Zone grants advantage
zoneAdvantage.Hint: While in The Zone attack rolls are made with advantage.

domainTracking.Name: Domain Expansion tracking
domainTracking.Hint: Expanding a domain adds a 1-minute effect; when it ends Technique Burnout is applied (2 exhaustion, techniques blocked).

domainSureHit.Name: Domain sure-hit reminders
domainSureHit.Hint: While your domain is open, technique attacks and saves post a sure-hit reminder in the chat.

autoExpire.Name: Expire JJK effects
autoExpire.Hint: Delete The Zone, Domain and Technique Burnout when their duration ends (skipped if the Times Up module is active).

headerButton.Name: JJK button on character sheets
headerButton.Hint: Show a JJK button in the header of character sheets to open the JJK panel.

importMenu.Name: Re-import JJK 5e content
importMenu.Label: Import / Update compendiums
importMenu.Hint: Rebuild the JJK 5e V.6 world compendiums from the module data.

modifierReminders.Name: Feat modifier reminders
modifierReminders.Hint: When you use a technique feature, list in the chat the feats you own that modify it.

checkPrereqs.Name: Check feat prerequisites
checkPrereqs.Hint: Warn when a feat or feature is added to an actor that does not meet its prerequisites (features, CE score, level, skill).

pointBuyBudget.Name: Point buy: points
pointBuyBudget.Hint: Points available for the point buy (default 27).

pointBuyMin.Name: Point buy: minimum score
pointBuyMin.Hint: Starting and minimum score for each ability (default 10).

pointBuyMax.Name: Point buy: maximum score
pointBuyMax.Hint: Highest score you can buy before race, background or class bonuses (default 18).

pointBuyDoubleFrom.Name: Point buy: double cost from
pointBuyDoubleFrom.Hint: Scores at or above this value cost 2 points each (default 14).

asiFeatPicker.Name: JJK feats in Ability Score Improvement
asiFeatPicker.Hint: Adds a list of the JJK feats you qualify for to every Ability Score Improvement step when you level up.

animations.Name: Animations (Sequencer + JB2A)
animations.Hint: Plays animations for JJK attacks, techniques, healing and domains when Sequencer and JB2A are active. Items you configured in Automated Animations keep their own animation.

animOverrides.Name: Animation overrides (JSON)
animOverrides.Hint: Optional JSON mapping animation keys to Sequencer database paths or files, e.g. {"melee": "jb2a.unarmed_strike.physical.02.blue", "domain": "jb2a.darkness.green"}.

sceneTools.Name: JJK buttons in the token toolbar
sceneTools.Hint: Shows one JJK button in the left Token controls toolbar that opens a compact menu with all JJK macros.

levelUpButton.Name: Level-up button on full XP bar
levelUpButton.Hint: Shows a Level up button under the XP bar when the character has enough experience. It opens the normal level-up dialog.

enableSummoning.Name: Enable shikigami summoning
enableSummoning.Hint: Turns on the system's Allow Summoning setting so Ten Shadows features place their shikigami tokens. Players without token permission get them placed by the GM automatically.

pointBuyCosts.Name: Point buy: cost table
pointBuyCosts.Hint: Total cost of each score, as score:cost pairs (default 10:0, 11:1, 12:2, 13:3, 14:5, 15:7, 16:10, 17:13, 18:17).

dataLanguage.Name: Compendium language
dataLanguage.Hint: Language of the imported compendium items and folders. The rules journals always include both the English original and the Spanish manual. Changing it asks to re-import.

sheetStrip.Name: JJK bar on the character sheet
sheetStrip.Hint: CE with +/−, grade, vows and quick buttons at the top of the sheet.

turnSummary.Name: Turn summary
turnSummary.Hint: At the start of your turn, whisper your CE, active vows and active forms.

autoHotbar.Name: Automatic JJK hotbar
autoHotbar.Hint: Refill the JJK hotbar page whenever a JJK item is added to your character.

hotbarPage.Name: JJK hotbar page
hotbarPage.Hint: Hotbar page (1–5) used for technique and CE abilities.

diceColors.Name: JJK dice colors (Dice So Nice)
diceColors.Hint: Purple dice for techniques, gold in a domain, black and red on a Black Flash.

domainZones.Name: Domain zone and barrier
domainZones.Hint: Draw the domain on the map, track barrier HP/AC, clashes and sure hit only inside.

tmfxAuras.Name: Token Magic FX auras
tmfxAuras.Hint: With Token Magic FX: a red glow on tokens in the Zone (after a Black Flash) and a purple glow while their domain is open.

fxDomains.Name: FXMaster domain tint
fxDomains.Hint: With FXMaster: tint the scene purple while a domain expansion is open.

strictPrereqs.Name: Enforce prerequisite checks for players
strictPrereqs.Hint: When enabled, a player cannot add a feat that fails the JJK requirement checks. GMs can still grant exceptions.

playerGMRequests.Name: Allow player requests for GM operations (manual approval)
playerGMRequests.Hint: Disabled by default. If enabled, requests still require active-GM confirmation; client-reported identity is not authenticated.

updateMenu.Name: Update items on actors
updateMenu.Label: Update automation
updateMenu.Hint: Replace the automation of JJK items already on actors with the current compendium version (keeps per-character state).

privateCE.Name: Private CE messages
privateCE.Hint: CE spent/regained chat lines are only shown to the character's owners and the GM.

tableView.Name: Table view
tableView.Hint: How module tables adapt. Automatic follows the window width: comfortable when wide, compact when medium, one card per row when narrow. Every window can be resized.

fluidWindows.Name: Fluid windows
fluidWindows.Hint: JJK windows and Sealed Ink sheets resize from any edge or corner, remember their size per window type, and stay on screen when the browser window changes.

Feats.OnePact: Only one Heavenly Pact per creature

PointBuy.Title: Point Buy
PointBuy.Hint: Every score starts at {min}. Spend up to {budget} points; {max} is the maximum before racial and other bonuses.
PointBuy.Order: Use this before adding your race, class or background so their ability bonuses are added on top.
PointBuy.Over: Over budget: {spent} of {budget} points. Lower a score to apply.

ASI.Hint: {n} JJK feats meet your prerequisites. Choose one instead of the ability score increase.
ASI.ChooseHint: Choose one: improve your ability scores, or take a feat instead.

LevelUp.Title: Level up
LevelUp.NoClass: This character has no class yet.
LevelUp.NeedAdvancements: Enable D&D 5e advancements to level up without losing features, HP or choices.
LevelUp.NoManager: JJK 5e: the D&D 5e advancement manager is not available, so this item cannot be added safely.

Vow.Title: Binding Vows
Vow.Name: Name
Vow.MechanicsHint: Optional. Positive numbers for benefits, negative for restrictions. They become an Active Effect.
Vow.LockWeek: The GM unlocks it (1 work week)
Vow.EndsNever: When you suspend or break it
Vow.OverLimit: {n} active vows exceed your limit ({max} = proficiency bonus). Allowed, but tell your GM.
Vow.PartnerManual: {name} must record the vow on their own sheet (you don't own that character).
Vow.Locked: This vow can't be suspended yet.
Vow.BreakConfirm: Break {name}? You lose its benefits and may suffer the punishment.
Vow.LostBenefits: All benefits of the vow are lost.
Vow.PersonalBreak: Personal vow: the GM decides any further consequence.
Vow.PunishmentHint: Choose: 5 levels of exhaustion for 10 days, or roll on the misfortune table.
Vow.DeleteConfirm: Delete this vow from the list (without in-game consequences)?

Career.Title: Sorcerer Career
Career.StepTrials: Pass 3 missions with a Grade 1 sorcerer ({n}/3)
Career.RecRule: Teachers can't recommend their own students.
Career.RecHint: Name of the Grade 1 sorcerer who recommends:
Career.TeacherNoRec: {teacher} is this sorcerer's teacher: teachers cannot recommend their own students.

Hotbar.Filled: {n} JJK abilities placed on hotbar page {page}.
Hotbar.NoPermission: Couldn't create macros. Ask the GM for the 'Create script macros' permission.

Curse.Place: Place a hidden token in view

Keys.HudHint: JJK: click = panel · right click = −1 CE · Shift + right click = +1 CE

Breakthrough.Name: Breakthroughs
Breakthrough.RCTYes: Reverse Cursed Technique awakened! Add the RCT feature.
Breakthrough.UnderstandingOffer: {name} now has {total} breakthroughs. The GM can grant the newly available Awakened Understanding:

Create.Title: JJK 5e: create a character

Step.abilities: Step 1 — Ability scores. Set your scores with point buy.
Step.class: Step 2 — Class. Pick a class; its level 1 choices include your Innate Technique.
Step.technique: Step 3 — Innate Technique. Confirm the technique of your character.
Step.race: Step 4 — Race. Pick a race and spend its ability bonuses.
Step.background: Step 5 — Background. Pick a background; technique feats only show those of your technique.

Create.Stopped: Character creation paused. Click Create character on the sheet to continue.
Create.OnlyTechnique: Only the {n} feats of your Innate Technique are shown.
Create.NoTechniqueYet: Choose your Innate Technique first (class level 1): technique feats are hidden until then.

StepHint.abilities: Point buy (do it first so race and class bonuses add on top).
StepHint.class: Its level 1 features include your innate technique.
StepHint.ceAbility: Wisdom or Charisma: sets your Cursed Energy pool and save DCs.
StepHint.race: Choose a race and assign its bonuses.
StepHint.background: Skills, tools and the background feat.
StepHint.feat: For variant or Techniqueless characters, or when the GM allows one.
StepHint.hotbar: Put your techniques and JJK actions on the hotbar.
StepHint.mindset: Alternative to Inspiration, if your table uses it.

Create.NoFeats: No JJK feat available: check prerequisites (level, technique, breakthroughs).
Create.FeatConfirm: Confirm that the character is entitled to an extra feat under the rules or a table ruling.

Shikigami.Title: Customize a shikigami
Shikigami.Hint: Creates your own copy of the creature (you can edit its stats, name and token). Your technique will summon your copy. ✎ = already yours: opens its sheet.
Shikigami.Created: {name} created: edit it freely, your summons now use it.
Shikigami.None: This character has no summon abilities.

Update.Title: Update JJK automation
Update.None: {name}: JJK automation is up to date.
Update.NoneWorld: All JJK items on actors are up to date.
Update.Prompt: {n} JJK item(s) on {name} have newer automation in the compendium:
Update.PromptWorld: {n} actor(s) have JJK items with newer automation:
Update.Keeps: Kept: uses spent, quantity, equipped/attuned, advancement choices, personal shikigami and your CE ability. Replaced: activities, effects, description and JJK flags.
Update.Notice: JJK 5e {version}: {n} actor(s) have items with outdated automation.

Builder.Title: Original Technique Builder
Builder.Intro: Build your own innate technique following the manual's guidelines: 1st Lapse, 3rd Lapse or Extension, 6th Extension, 11th Maximum, 18th Domain Expansion. Leave a feature name empty to skip it. The items are created in the Items directory (folder “JJK: Custom Techniques”) and can then be chosen like any technique.
Builder.Name: Technique name
Builder.EarlyDomain: Domain Expansion at 3rd level (weaker sure-hit, as Deadly Sentencing or Pachinko Fever)
Builder.Created: {name}: {n} technique feature(s) created in the Items directory.
Builder.NoPermission: You need permission to create items (ask the GM).

Opt.Title: Optional rules
Opt.Intro: Optional rules from the JJK 5e manual. Each one is off until you enable it; enabled rules are automated by the module.

Action.ChargeHint: +10 ft in a straight line; only 1 attack this turn.
Action.CoupDie: — on a failure the target dies.
Action.CoupHint: Attack now; the target saves with DC = damage.
Action.DistractDC: +1 to its concentration DC until your next turn.
Action.SunderHint: Damage beyond the item's Hardness reduces its HP; half HP or less = broken (−3); below 0 you may destroy it.

Called.Crippled: crippled — roll on the Limb Damage table.
Called.On: Next attack is a called shot (−5).

Clash.Done: reduces the next damage by {n} ({left} uses left).
Clash.Effect: The next damage you take is reduced by {n}.
Clash.NoUses: No clashes left ({max} per long rest).
Clash.Overflow: the attacker takes {n} if within range

CritSave.One: natural 1 on the save: critical damage (×2)
CritSave.Twenty: natural 20 on the save: no damage

Death.Confirm: Turn {name} into a cursed spirit (race Vengeful Spirit, loses RCT features, STR/DEX/CON/CE +2, other mental scores −4, 1 level of indefinite madness)?
Death.Done: {name} rises as a cursed spirit. {n} RCT feature(s) lost, +{pp} Profane Points.
Death.Feat: Cursed Upon Death: Cursed Energy or Innate Technique feat
Death.Free: {name} passes the weekly save: the madness ends.
Death.MadnessHint: Each week: DC 25 Wisdom save. Failure: +1 level; success: the madness ends.

Evasion.Done: {name} sacrifices the {limb} ({n} damage) and escapes the execution.
Evasion.Prompt: Which limb do you remove at the point of contact?

Fight.Done: {name} fights for their life (exhaustion {n}/5 from this rule).
Fight.Max: Already 5 levels of exhaustion from Fight for your Life.

Find.Create: Create a {label} cursed spirit on the scene?

Money.Prompt: How do you earn money this week?
Money.SellConfirm: Sell {item} for {n}? The item is removed.
Money.WageHint: Weekly pay ($80–500, set by the GM):

ObjectSoul.L1: melee attacks ignore damage thresholds and reduction of objects
ObjectSoul.L2: maximum damage against objects; their AC counts as 5 lower
ObjectSoul.L3: ignore techniques that harden objects; blindsight 30 ft

Repeat.Found: {name} has {lesser} and {better}: the GM may let the player swap {lesser} for another feat.

TakeHit.Effect: You take double damage from the attack you intercepted.

Totality.Back: {name}'s fallen shikigami return after the long rest.
Totality.Dead: this shikigami is dead and cannot be summoned again (eligible for Totality).
Totality.Returns: this shikigami falls; it returns after a long rest.
Totality.UntilRest: This shikigami returns after a long rest.

Tough.Applied: {name}: +{hp} HP, +{dmg} damage, +{dc} save DC, +2 to two abilities.
Tough.Effect: Tough Trials: remove it when the taming ends.

Understanding.Have: Only one Class Specific Understanding per character.

totalityAlt.Name: Totality Alternative
totalityAlt.Hint: Ignore Totality: shikigami are not killed; every fallen shikigami comes back on a long rest (and none becomes eligible for Totality).

lessBlood.Name: Less Blood
lessBlood.Hint: The hit point costs of Rot and Blood Manipulation are reduced to the chosen fraction (minimum 1).

bloodConversion.Name: Blood Conversion
bloodConversion.Hint: With the Blood Production feat, rolls to acquire or understand the basics of the Reverse Cursed Technique are made with advantage.

mythicalAccuracy.Name: Mythical Beast Accuracy
mythicalAccuracy.Hint: Mythical Beast Amber Release advances one stage per turn (at the start of each of its user's turns).

advantageStacking.Name: Advantage Stacking
advantageStacking.Hint: Advantage from more than one source: roll with advantage plus +1 for each extra source. Automated for attack rolls; for skill checks, and for Help (which needs a described way of helping or proficiency), apply it by hand.

crunchyCrits.Name: Crunchy Crits
crunchyCrits.Hint: On a critical hit, instead of doubling the damage dice, roll normally and double the entire damage roll (modifiers and flat bonuses included).

criticalSaves.Name: Critical Saves
criticalSaves.Hint: A natural 1 on a saving throw against a damaging effect means critical damage (applied as ×2); a natural 20 means no damage.

callingShots.Name: Calling Shots
callingShots.Hint: Take −5 on the attack to cripple a creature. If the damage exceeds the maximum of the target's hit die + its Constitution modifier, roll on the Limb Damage table (or the GM decides the injury).

fightForLife.Name: Fight for your Life
fightForLife.Hint: While making death saving throws: advantage on the next one, at the cost of 1 level of exhaustion (up to 5 levels this way).

takeTheHit.Name: Take the Hit
takeTheHit.Hint: Reaction: when a creature within your movement is targeted or hit by a harmful effect, move up to your speed toward it and take the attack in its place; you take twice the damage.

weaponClash.Name: Clash
weaponClash.Hint: Reaction against an attack or damaging effect aimed at you: roll damage for a melee weapon attack and reduce the damage by that much; any excess hits the attacker if within range. Not against psychic damage unless you have a feature that deals psychic damage. Uses: proficiency bonus per long rest.

flanking.Name: Flanking
flanking.Hint: Two creatures (not incapacitated) within 5 ft on opposite sides of another creature have advantage on attacks against it (or +2, if the GM prefers).

techniqueless.Name: Techniqueless
techniqueless.Hint: Without an Innate Technique (and without New Shadow Style or Divergent Fist): +2 ASI and a feat at 1st and 3rd level, +3 ASI and a feat at 6th and 11th, +3 ASI and 2 feats at 18th. Asked on level up.

repetitiveAbilities.Name: Repetitive Abilities
repetitiveAbilities.Hint: If a character gains a feature that gives the same or a better version of a feat they already have (Domain Expansion / Incomplete Domain, Reverse Technique Understanding / Reversed Technique Prodigy), the GM may let them swap that feat for another they qualify for.

featImprovement.Name: Feat Improvement
featImprovement.Hint: Whenever a character gains an Ability Score Improvement, they also gain a feat they qualify for.

pureBarrier.Name: Pure Barrier
pureBarrier.Hint: Inside a Pure Barrier (scene flag), characters with the barrier holder's permission spend only 1 CE to cast Curtain.

executionEvasion.Name: Execution Evasion
executionEvasion.Hint: A creature aware of the Executioner's Sword can use its reaction when hit to remove a limb at the point of contact: it takes the damage needed to remove that limb (cannot be reduced) and avoids instant death.

soulChecks.Name: Soul Checks
soulChecks.Hint: Checks about souls use your Soul Awareness level instead of ability modifiers or proficiencies; with no level, they are made with disadvantage.

outputBurnout.Name: Output Burnout
outputBurnout.Hint: While under Technique Burnout you gain 2 temporary levels of Reduced Output.

increasedAffinity.Name: Increased Affinity
increasedAffinity.Hint: Characters of a Cursed Spirit race gain Increased Affinity at 10th level (bonus action or reaction: spend up to your CE modifier in CE to regain 10 HP per CE).

sixEyesDependency.Name: Six Eyes Dependency
sixEyesDependency.Hint: Without the Six Eyes: activating and maintaining Infinity costs 3 CE; Lapse Blue, Reversal Red, Teleportation and Offensive Infinity cost double; Hollow Purple costs 5 CE more.

increasedHP.Name: Increased Hit Points
increasedHP.Hint: On level up, characters gain the maximum value of their hit die instead of rolling or taking the average.

toughTrials.Name: Tough Trials
toughTrials.Hint: GM button for untamed shikigami: +10 × CR HP, +2 × CR to damage rolls, +½ CR to the DC of its features and +2 to two ability scores. Remove it when the taming ritual ends (never keep these increases).

additionalActions.Name: Additional Actions
additionalActions.Hint: Optional actions for dynamic combat: Distract, Sunder, Coup de Grace and Charge (items in JJK Class Features).

classUnderstanding.Name: Class Specific Understandings
classUnderstanding.Hint: A character of the class with at least 2 Breakthroughs can gain that class's understanding. Only one per character.

moneyRules.Name: Ways to Make Money
moneyRules.Hint: Money tracker with minimum wage jobs, special employment (Innate Technique or RCT), mission pay by grade and cursed tool sales (Tool Maker).

yearlyProgression.Name: Yearly Progression
yearlyProgression.Hint: GM button: one ability score +2 or two +1 (max 20), or a new feat with the GM's approval. Up to four times per character.

findCurse.Name: Finding a Cursed Spirit
findCurse.Hint: 1-2 hours of searching: DC 20 Perception or Investigation check; on a success, d100 for the grade.

cursedUponDeath.Name: Cursed Upon Death
cursedUponDeath.Hint: GM button: a human sorcerer killed without cursed energy comes back a week later as a cursed spirit (Vengeful Spirit race), with the manual's changes.

objectSoul.Name: Object Soul Awareness
objectSoul.Hint: Track its 3 levels (raised with Spiritual Teaching, or alone with 6+ levels of Soul Awareness). Level 3 gives blindsight 30 ft.

Opt.MidiFlanking: Midi-QOL already has Flanking on: its rule is used and the JJK one is skipped.

RCT.Already: {name} already has the Reverse Cursed Technique.
RCT.Moment: {name}: {why}. The GM can bestow the Reverse Cursed Technique or let them roll (d100, 90+).
RCT.Nat20: natural 20 after two failed death saves
RCT.OneHit: reduced from maximum HP to 0 in one hit
RCT.UnlockedHint: RCT features added and +1 Breakthrough (Awakened Understanding).
RCT.Allowed: {name} may roll for the Reverse Cursed Technique (d100, 90+) from the JJK panel.
RCT.NoChance: Only in a near-death moment the GM allows.
RCT.Physiology: {name} is a Cursed Spirit: instead of Reverse Cursed Technique it awakens its Cursed Physiology ({points} Profane Points, +1 per level).

GMRequest.Title: JJK 5e: player request
GMRequest.Verify: Client identifiers cannot be trusted. Check with the player before approving.

Midi.Title: Full Midi automation (JJK)
Midi.NoConfig: Could not read the Midi-QOL settings.
Midi.Already: Midi-QOL already rolls attacks, damage and saves automatically.
Midi.Confirm: These Midi-QOL workflow settings change so that using a technique rolls the attack, checks the hit, rolls damage on a hit, rolls the targets' saves and applies damage and effects:
Midi.Backup: The previous values are saved; use 'Undo Midi automation' to restore them.
Midi.Done: Midi-QOL: {n} settings changed for full automation.

Clash.Offer: {opener} expanded a domain. {name} can use the reaction to expand their own domain and start a Domain Clash.
Clash.Hint: The domain's CE cost, burnout and the clash by refinement apply as usual.
Clash.NoDomain: This character has no Domain Expansion.
Clash.Expired: This domain reaction is no longer available.

Diag.Title: JJK integration diagnostics
Diag.NotCertification: Runtime detection is not a compatibility certification.
Diag.Refund: Refund (after checking there were no effects)
Diag.ConfirmHint: Check the native workflow, damage, effects and other resources first.

Fall.Name: Fall damage
Fall.Prompt: Height fallen in feet (max 200). Damage die by size: Tiny 1, Small d4, Medium d6, Large d8, Huge d10, Gargantuan d12 per 10 ft.

School.Title: Jujutsu High
School.None: Not enrolled at a jujutsu school.
School.Hint: Students pick their year and teacher; teachers see their students here. Teachers cannot recommend their own students for promotion.

Rest.Uncertain: Hit Dice/CE exchange uncertain: the GM must review this actor's record. Do not retry.
Rest.Mixed: Mixed values: compare and correct the resources by hand before reconciling.
Rest.MatchApplied: The current values match the applied exchange: mark it as completed?
Rest.MatchPrior: The current values match the state before the exchange: reopen it?
Rest.NeedShortRest: Finish a short rest on the character sheet first: Hit Dice can be exchanged for CE once per short rest, out of combat.
Rest.InReview: The last Hit Dice/CE exchange is waiting for the GM to reconcile it.
Rest.Confirm: Spend {n} Hit Dice to recover {n} CE?

Totality.Hint: Confirm this is a tamed shikigami. If the summoner sees it fall and still has a reaction, it can be recalled until a long rest. During a taming ritual or if unsure, do not confirm the loss.
